meta.title: Shande Villa — Street photography in Guangzhou
meta.description: I'm a Spanish street photographer living in Guangzhou. My photos, my links (Instagram, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Substack) and how to reach me for brand collaborations.
portada.alt: A person seen from behind under a red umbrella, next to a wet crosswalk at night
portada.bio: I'm a street photographer from Spain, and I live in Guangzhou, in southern China. I go out for walks with my camera and photograph whatever crosses my path: people, light, things that may not be there tomorrow. I'm not after the perfect picture, just the one that feels like that moment.
